facts.business: Rainbow Foundations Limited operates in the real estate sector, engaged in construction and development of residential and commercial properties in India.
key_risks: High input cost increase due to geopolitical tensions or otherwise
Steep increase in interest rates in general and mortgage rates in particular
Delays in approvals and adherence to regulations prolonging project timelines and increasing costs
facts.related_party_note: The Company has a Policy on Related Party Transactions available on its website http://www.rainbowfoundations.in.
